theme: Independent chronology and recovery contexts for HARP seals
question: Which source-qualified HARP seal identities and context dates can support a later independent chronological cohort?
outcome: Nine unique CISI identities receive source-qualified context dispositions. Two explicit uncontested full keys are preserved; H-2587 retains conflicting lots 7158 and 7458. Three early Mound E seals remain field-context candidates. Two mixed-context seals carry style-based 3C revisions. No new independent calendar sample or eligible confirmation seal is established, and no legend statistic is scored.
challenge: The public synthesis omits individual field context links and contains an internal lot contradiction. A linked 2009 chapter returned HTTP 403 and exceeded the web PDF size limit.
remedy: Preserved both lot assertions, separated deposit and style dates, retained snippet-only chronology as unverified, and kept all detailed records and text extraction on D:.
retry_when: Field lots and stratigraphic relations are recovered for H-1688, H-1682 and H-1692, independently contextualized late HARP seals become available, or a primary witness resolves H-2587. Reserve all later text scoring for a jointly frozen design.
